title: Bimagrumab plus semaglutide alone or in combination for the treatment of obesity: a randomized phase 2 trial
comparison_or_design: The comparison of bimagrumab 30 mg/kg plus semaglutide 2.4 mg with semaglutide 2.4 mg plus matching bimagrumab placebo.
observations_or_assays: Total body fat mass by DXA
Total body lean mass by DXA
time_scope: Baseline to week 48 in the primary treatment period; preserve the source-defined estimand for each selected result.
excluded: All other arms, placebo-only comparisons, week-72 extension and treatment-regimen analyses beyond the explicitly selected main Table 2 absolute-weight comparison
Appendicular/visceral measures, waist, responder categories, metabolic and safety outcomes
population_or_material: The source-defined analysis populations for the selected main Table 2 absolute-weight comparison and the Results fat/lean analyses in the primary 48-week treatment period.
requested_items: Selected two arms only: main Table 2 absolute weight LSM change, efficacy-estimand Results percentage fat/lean LSM changes, and explicit tests against semaglutide 2.4 mg. Preserve each source estimand; exclude double-placebo contrasts, other arms and week 72.
